lessons.session: Diagnostic: greetings & ordinal numbers (45 mn)
lessons.topic: Diagnostic: greetings & ordinal numbers — Welcome back! 1st to 10th
lessons.materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks
objectives: Greet friends, welcome a new classmate, say and write ordinal numbers (1st-10th).
Target structures: I am + name; Nice to meet you.
Lexis: Good morning / Hello / Hi; Welcome to our school; Nice to meet you; first...tenth.
lessons.body:
Domain: Diagnostic: greetings & ordinal numbers
Objective: Greet friends, welcome a new classmate, say and write ordinal numbers (1st-10th).
Target structures: I am + name; Nice to meet you.
Lexis: Good morning / Hello / Hi; Welcome to our school; Nice to meet you; first...tenth.
Textbook activities: Song 'Back to School'; picture dialogue (Nadjib, Fadi, Selma...); ordinal-numbers train; Task One (order the letters on the slate).
Materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks

▪ Warm-up (5 min): Teacher: Greet pupils and let them greet one another ('Good morning, friends'). Ask: 'What is your name?'.
   Learners: Greet, answer, sing, recall previous knowledge.
   [Whole class]
▪ Presentation (12 min): Teacher: Play the song twice; pupils listen and sing. Present the picture: Fadi is a new pupil; model 'Welcome to our school, Fadi' / 'Nice to meet you'. Show the train: teacher says the ordinals, pupils repeat chorally then individually.
   Learners: Listen, observe, repeat chorally then individually, discover the meaning.
   [Whole class / pairs]
▪ Practice (15 min): Teacher: Task One: pupils order the letters A-J on the slate according to the ordinal given (1st = A, 7th = G...). Quick check by flashing cards: 'Who is the 5th?'.
   Learners: Do the tasks on the slate / copybook, check with a partner, correct.
   [Individual / pairs]
▪ Production (10 min): Teacher: In groups of 4 pupils stand in a line, greet a 'new pupil' and say their rank ('I am the third').
   Learners: Interact orally or in writing with a partner / group and report to the class.
   [Pairs / groups]
▪ Evaluation & homework (3 min): Teacher: Check the objective with 2-3 quick questions or a mini-quiz. Homework: Write the ordinals from 1st to 10th in the copybook.
   Learners: Self-assess and note the homework.
   [Individual]

lessons.session: Diagnostic: cardinal numbers 30-100 (45 mn)
lessons.topic: Diagnostic: cardinal numbers 30-100 — How old are you?
lessons.materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks
objectives: Say, read and write numbers from 30 to 100; ask and answer about age.
Target structures: How old are you? I am + number.
Lexis: thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred; thirty-one...thirty-nine.
lessons.body:
Domain: Diagnostic: cardinal numbers 30-100
Objective: Say, read and write numbers from 30 to 100; ask and answer about age.
Target structures: How old are you? I am + number.
Lexis: thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred; thirty-one...thirty-nine.
Textbook activities: Number table (30-100); Task Two (write in numbers); Task Three (role-play 'How old are you, grandfather?').
Materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks

▪ Warm-up (5 min): Teacher: Count from 0 to 30 together; mental game: teacher says a number, pupils say the next one.
   Learners: Greet, answer, sing, recall previous knowledge.
   [Whole class]
▪ Presentation (12 min): Teacher: Write 30-39 on the board; model pronunciation, stressing the endings -ty / -teen contrast. Then 40, 50...100.
   Learners: Listen, observe, repeat chorally then individually, discover the meaning.
   [Whole class / pairs]
▪ Practice (15 min): Teacher: Task Two on the copybook: write 31-36 in figures. Dictation of 5 numbers on slates.
   Learners: Do the tasks on the slate / copybook, check with a partner, correct.
   [Individual / pairs]
▪ Production (10 min): Teacher: Task Three: pairs play the roles (Mohamed 70, Souad 65, Ahmed 45, Affef 31, Abdullah 40, Khadidja 38): 'How old are you?' - 'I am...'.
   Learners: Interact orally or in writing with a partner / group and report to the class.
   [Pairs / groups]
▪ Evaluation & homework (3 min): Teacher: Check the objective with 2-3 quick questions or a mini-quiz. Homework: Write your family members' ages in words.
   Learners: Self-assess and note the homework.
   [Individual]

lessons.body:
Domain: Diagnostic: shapes
Objective: Name basic shapes and colours; follow a drawing instruction; evaluate prerequisites (diagnostic).
Target structures: It is a + shape. It is + colour.
Lexis: circle, square, rectangle, triangle, star, crescent, heart, oval; colours.
Textbook activities: 'Let's learn about shapes'; Task Four (draw the house, name the shapes, colour them).
Materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks

   Learners: Greet, answer, sing, recall previous knowledge.
   [Whole class]
▪ Presentation (12 min): Teacher: Show the 8 shapes on flashcards; repeat chorally; pupils draw each in the air.
   Learners: Listen, observe, repeat chorally then individually, discover the meaning.
   [Whole class / pairs]
▪ Practice (15 min): Teacher: Task Four: draw the house on the copybook, name each shape (a circle on the roof...) and colour it as in the model.
   Learners: Do the tasks on the slate / copybook, check with a partner, correct.
   [Individual / pairs]
▪ Production (10 min): Teacher: Pairs: one describes a shape ('It is a red heart'), the partner draws it. Diagnostic grid: note who masters greetings, numbers, shapes.
   Learners: Interact orally or in writing with a partner / group and report to the class.
   [Pairs / groups]
▪ Evaluation & homework (3 min): Teacher: Check the objective with 2-3 quick questions or a mini-quiz. Homework: Draw a picture using at least 4 shapes and write 4 sentences.
   Learners: Self-assess and note the homework.
   [Individual]

lessons.topic: I listen and repeat — What do you want to be?
lessons.materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks
objectives: Name and identify common jobs; say what people do and where they work.

lessons.body:
Domain: I listen and repeat
Objective: Name and identify common jobs; say what people do and where they work.
Target structures: I am a/an + job. I + verb (present simple). What do you do? Where do you work?
Lexis: barber, teacher, mechanic, surgeon, engineer, builder, gardener; cut hair, teach Arabic, repair cars; barber shop, school, garage.
Textbook activities: Opener p.10 (jobs, tools, places); song 'What do you want to be?'; 'I repeat' (barber, teacher, mechanic); 'I look, listen and repeat'; Tasks One-Four.
Materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks

▪ Warm-up (5 min): Teacher: Mime a job (cutting hair, driving); pupils guess in Arabic then English: 'a barber'.
   Learners: Greet, answer, sing, recall previous knowledge.
   [Whole class]
▪ Presentation (12 min): Teacher: Play the song; elicit the jobs. Present the 3 pictures: 'I am a barber. I cut hair in a barber shop.' Pupils repeat. Look, listen and repeat: the doctor picture.
   Learners: Listen, observe, repeat chorally then individually, discover the meaning.
   [Whole class / pairs]
▪ Practice (15 min): Teacher: Task One (listen & choose: Tarek's father...), Task Two (guess the job from the pictures), Task Four (complete with drive/paint/teach/repair).
   Learners: Do the tasks on the slate / copybook, check with a partner, correct.
   [Individual / pairs]
▪ Production (10 min): Teacher: Task Three: match jobs and activities (teacher-teaches Arabic...); pairs mime and say 'I am a... I...'.
   Learners: Interact orally or in writing with a partner / group and report to the class.
   [Pairs / groups]
▪ Evaluation & homework (3 min): Teacher: Check the objective with 2-3 quick questions or a mini-quiz. Homework: Copy Task Four sentences completed.
   Learners: Self-assess and note the homework.
   [Individual]

lessons.session: Section 1 — I read and discover (45 mn)

lessons.materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks
objectives: Read a short text about a job; identify the sound /dʒ/ in 'bridge, engineer, huge, jump, job'.
Target structures: He is / He works / He designs (3rd person -s, implicit).
Lexis: engineer, neighbour, office, designs, huge bridges, active, loves.
lessons.body:
Domain: I read and discover
Objective: Read a short text about a job; identify the sound /dʒ/ in 'bridge, engineer, huge, jump, job'.
Target structures: He is / He works / He designs (3rd person -s, implicit).
Lexis: engineer, neighbour, office, designs, huge bridges, active, loves.
Textbook activities: 'Djamel the Engineer'; 'Read and repeat the words'; Task One (words with the sound of 'bridge'); Task Two (sound of 'huge'); Task Three (find the mistakes); Task Four (complete the conversation).
Materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks

▪ Warm-up (5 min): Teacher: Show a bridge picture; ask 'What do you see?'. Elicit 'engineer'.
   Learners: Greet, answer, sing, recall previous knowledge.
   [Whole class]
▪ Presentation (12 min): Teacher: Read the text aloud while pupils follow; comprehension questions (Who is Djamel? Where does he work?). Phonics: say bridge / engineer / Nadjib / jump, highlight /dʒ/ in the coloured letters.
   Learners: Listen, observe, repeat chorally then individually, discover the meaning.
   [Whole class / pairs]
▪ Practice (15 min): Teacher: Task One: copy judge, jacket, fridge, village (same sound); Task Two on the table words (jail, age, jar, job, surgeon, journalist, jeans, message, orange, vegetables). Task Three: find the mistakes in the wrong text.
   Learners: Do the tasks on the slate / copybook, check with a partner, correct.
   [Individual / pairs]
▪ Production (10 min): Teacher: Task Four: pairs complete and act the conversation 'Are you a doctor, uncle Djamel?'.
   Learners: Interact orally or in writing with a partner / group and report to the class.
   [Pairs / groups]
▪ Evaluation & homework (3 min): Teacher: Check the objective with 2-3 quick questions or a mini-quiz. Homework: Copy 5 words with /dʒ/ and draw them.
   Learners: Self-assess and note the homework.
   [Individual]

lessons.body:
Domain: I read and write
Objective: Read and complete a table; punctuate and capitalize a dialogue; write sentences about a job.
Target structures: I am a... I make... I work in a...
Lexis: potter, jars, jugs, clay, workshop, potter's wheel, decorate, artisan.
Textbook activities: 'Julia the Artisan'; Task One (table: job, activity, material, workplace, tool); Task Two (punctuate & capitalize); Written Production (potter / teacher table).
Materials: textbook 'My Book of English', flashcards, audio / teacher's voice, board, slates, copybooks

   Learners: Greet, answer, sing, recall previous knowledge.
   [Whole class]
▪ Presentation (12 min): Teacher: Read the text aloud; ask: What is Julia's job? Where does she work? Explain capital letters, '?', '.', '!' with the dialogue 'are you an electrician adel'.
   Learners: Listen, observe, repeat chorally then individually, discover the meaning.
   [Whole class / pairs]
▪ Practice (15 min): Teacher: Task One: fill the table on the copybook (potter / makes jars / clay / workshop / potter's wheel). Task Two: rewrite 'Are you an electrician, Adel? Yes, I am.'.
   Learners: Do the tasks on the slate / copybook, check with a partner, correct.
   [Individual / pairs]
▪ Production (10 min): Teacher: Written production: use the table to write 'I am a potter. I make jars. I work in a workshop.' then 'I am a teacher...'.
   Learners: Interact orally or in writing with a partner / group and report to the class.
   [Pairs / groups]
▪ Evaluation & homework (3 min): Teacher: Check the objective with 2-3 quick questions or a mini-quiz. Homework: Write 3 sentences about a job you like.
   Learners: Self-assess and note the homework.

lessons.session: Section 1 — I read and enjoy (45 mn)

lessons.body:
Domain: I listen and repeat
Objective: Name tools of different jobs; use the possessive case 's to say whose it is.
Target structures: This is Sami's mic. It is the policeman's whistle. (possessive 's)
Lexis: mic, scissors, trowel, sewing machine, journalist, builder, tailor, camera, ladder, spanner.
Textbook activities: Song 'What do you want to be?'; 'I repeat' (Sami's mic, Reda's scissors, Omar's trowel, Samira's sewing machine); look, listen and repeat (surgeon); Tasks One-Four.
